title: 对象合并
problem_statement_md:
你正在制作一个锻炼的应用程序。在完成应用程序中的基本练习后，用户能够访问高级内容。

给定的程序声明了两个对象--`basic`和`advanced`，并有相应的属性。

完善代码，将`basic`和`advanced`合并成一个新的对象，并命名为**total**，并输出合并对象`total`的各个属性。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]ES6 Objects[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You are making a workout app. After completing the basic exercises in the app, the user is able to access advanced content.
The given program declares two classes - basic and advanced with corresponding properties. Complete the code to combine basic and advanced level exercises into one new object named [b]total[/b], so that the given code for final output works correctly.

[note]Use [b]Object.assign()[/b] to perform the requested operation.[/note]
hint_md: 使用`Object.assign()`来执行对象合并的操作。
